# Use BFS to find diagonal-connected components
def flood_fill_diagonal(grid, start_r, start_c, target):
    """Find all cells diagonally connected to start"""
    color = grid[target]
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    visited = [[False]*cols for _ in range(rows)]
    queue = [(start_r, start_c)]
    visited[start_r][start_c] = True
    result = []

        r, c = queue.pop(0)
        result.append((r, c))
        for dr, dc in [(-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,-1),(1,1)]:
            nr, nc = r+dr, c+dc
            if (0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and 
                grid[nr][nc] == color and not visited[nr][nc]):
                visited[nr][nc] = True
                queue.append((nr, nc))
    return result
